page_title: LLM Optimizer — AI Search Visibility for Marketers

sources.entry: LLM Optimizer - AI brand visibility tool (like SEO for LLMs, or GEO). Measures how ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity cite and recommend your brand with composite AI Visibility Scores, per-dimension analysis, and prioritized optimization recommendations.

summary.name: LLM Optimizer
summary.one_liner: A web tool that analyzes how ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity represent and recommend a brand, then scores visibility and suggests improvements.
use_cases: Checking whether ChatGPT or Perplexity recommends your brand
Scoring brand visibility across AI search engines
Finding gaps in how LLMs describe a company
Prioritizing actions to improve AI search presence
Comparing brand visibility against competitors via sample reports
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a tool that measures how ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity cite and recommend a brand. Users enter a domain to run an analysis, or view a sample report. According to the listing, it produces composite AI Visibility Scores, per-dimension analysis, and prioritized optimization recommendations. The page shows a "popular brands" section with example scores and report counts for sample domains. The page text itself gives few technical details about methods or data sources.
notable: Composite AI Visibility Score per brand
Per-dimension analysis of LLM brand representation
caveats: Pricing and plan details are not shown on the page
Page text is mostly marketing; methodology for scores is not described
